googleConnect.description: Connect {channel} with your Google account. Youtorch uses its own Google app; you never enter tokens or Google Cloud keys.
googleConnect.hint: A Google window opens; then choose the YouTube channel.
googleConnect.popupOpen: Finish in the Google window that opened.
googleConnect.popupBlocked: The browser blocked the Google window. Allow pop-ups and try again.
googleConnect.notCompleted: The Google window was closed before the connection finished.
googleConnect.noChannels: This Google account has no YouTube channel.
googleConnect.bindFailed: The YouTube channel could not be linked to this workspace channel.
googleConnect.unavailableTitle: Google connection is not available yet
googleConnect.unavailableDescription: YouTube can't be connected in this environment right now.
googleConnect.reauthDescription: Google asks you to sign in again before Youtorch can use this channel.
